data.title: 结城美柑 · 结城家厨房的元气早餐料理
data.action: 在晨光厨房的料理台前单手握着平底锅熟练煎蛋，回头展颜微笑唤哥哥吃早餐
data.camera: medium shot, slightly low angle, warm domestic composition
data.lighting: 明净晨光穿过厨房百叶窗，灶台与发梢泛起柔和金芒
data.location: 洒满金色朝阳的结城家开放式厨房
data.description: 清晨的结城家厨房里飘出烤面包与煎蛋的香气。美柑穿着暖黄色围裙熟练地翻动平底锅，听到楼梯上传来哥哥迷迷糊糊的脚步声，她微微侧头露出甜美又带着一丝小恶魔调侃的笑容——「再慢吞吞的话，早餐可就要被菈菈吃光了哦，哥哥？」
data.promptProse: Standing by the sunlit kitchen counter in the Yuuki residence, Mikan holds a frying pan with an easy, practiced grip while turning to look back with a warm, mildly mischievous smile. Bright morning light streams across her chestnut bangs and the kitchen tiles.
data.animaCaption: She turns back from the kitchen counter while keeping a practiced grip on the frying pan.
